rows.name: vm_queryRange
rows.test_scope: no semantic execution tests claimed
implemented_cases: Ordinary-function Bytes/Array inclusive range; modes0..3; signed Int/Real endpoints with legacy truncation; clipping/empty results; par8 ignored
String strncpy NUL padding; max65536 result bytes; new Array top cells with shared nested values; selected direct dead Object source normalization committed atomically
One-instruction budget; zero-budget inert; inherited/cross-object frame preservation
excluded_cases: Buffer and other source types; direct References; range references/writes; lifecycle initialization/construction/rollback; default expressions
Modes outside0..3; native failure-side endpoint mutation/early pops; native shared empty-array identity; native string length/resource policy equivalence
Range errors are fatal and never acquire catch fault provenance; OOM and Cell ID rollback not guaranteed
dependencies: Buffer value representation; lifecycle/default-expression design; native failure/catch evidence
rows.exit_criteria: Extend excluded types and contexts only with native evidence and combined alias, bounds, failure-state and cleanup tests; no business execution claim.
